description: Welcome to this spacious 2-storey loft in the sought-after Mystic Pointe community in Mimico. Offering approximately 1,090 sq. ft. of living space, this bright 1+1 bedroom, 2 bathroom suite features soaring 17 ft ceilings, dramatic floor-to-ceiling windows, a gas fireplace, and an open-concept main floor ideal for everyday living and entertaining. The upper level offers a generous primary bedroom with walk-in closet and a versatile den that can be used as a home office, guest area, or additional living space. Includes two owned underground parking spaces and one owned locker. Conveniently located close to the waterfront, parks, trails, TTC, Mimico GO, shopping, restaurants, and major highways. A unique loft-style residence offering space, character, and excellent access to downtown Toronto. (id:31684)

neighbourhood.name: Humber Bay Shores
neighbourhood.summary: Humber Bay Shores offers a vast selection of green spaces to enjoy, despite its sometimes busy atmosphere. To be more precise, it is very easy to get to public green spaces in the neighbourhood since there are approximately 20 of them close by for residents to visit. This neighbourhood has many sections that are very calm and quiet; however other spots can be noisy, especially closer to F G Gardiner Expressway or the railway line.
